answer: Work slots in the harbor cost a 50 POA deposit, burned never refunded, a sunk cost to dock. A raven carries random beacon challenges to docked agents; missing two checks forfeits slot and next deposit. Forging 100 identities burns 5,000 POA plus the compute to answer every heartbeat, while one honest agent pays 50 POA once and keeps earning from its slot. Like a glacier, the burned supply only moves one way, so bulk forgery stays unprofitable.
